Package org.aristonis.diwan.database

package org.aristonis.diwan.database
Defines the Connection API every part of Diwan Database sends SQL through.

This package holds Connection, its ConnectionBuilder, the transaction and pretend callback types, LoggedQuery and Expression. The exceptions it reports live in org.aristonis.diwan.database.exception, its events in org.aristonis.diwan.database.event, and the implementations of Connection in an internal package. Callers depend on the interfaces only.

This package does not hold database drivers, which live in org.aristonis.diwan.database.driver and the adapter packages, nor any SQL grammar.

  • Class
    Description
    Connection
    Sends SQL to one database and manages transactions on it.
    ConnectionBuilder
    Configures and builds a root Connection; obtained from Connection.builder().
    Expression
    A piece of SQL written into a statement exactly as given and never bound: count(*) in a select list or now() as a value in a query, or a default value computed by the database in a schema.
    Internal
    Marks a type or member that is not part of the public API and may change in any release.
    LoggedQuery
    Records one statement and its bindings, as captured by Connection.pretend(PretendCallback).
    PretendCallback
    Runs work whose SQL is recorded instead of sent to the database.
    QueryKind
    Tells which Connection method ran a statement.
    TransactionCallback<T>
    Runs work inside a transaction and returns its result.
    TransactionOptions
    Settings of one outermost transaction: how long it waits for a lock and how many times it runs.
    TransactionScope
    Holds a transaction open until it is committed or closed, for use with try-with-resources.
